snippet.title: New project ─ Make it re a l
snippet.description:
Hello everyone ! 

After six months of preparation and hardwork Re.A.L will be back in september with many surprises and new projects. 
If you wanna be part of this don't miss the chance to come to Re.A.L.'s audition that will be hold at the begining of september. 
The applicants must be 18+, live in Paris, be motivated and a hardworker. 

To enroll you only need to send an email to realofficialcrew@gmail.com or via http://www.facebook.com/realofficialcrew with a presentation and the reasons of why you wanna enter the crew. 

Good luck ! And see you soon for more surprises. 
Re.A.L. team.

snippet.title: New project ─ Make it re a l
snippet.description:
Hello everyone ! 

After six months of preparation and hardwork Re.A.L will be back in september with many surprises and new projects. 
If you wanna be part of this don't miss the chance to come to Re.A.L.'s audition that will be hold at the begining of september. 
The applicants must be 18+, live in Paris, be motivated and a hardworker. 

To enroll you only need to send an email to realofficialcrew@gmail.com or via http://www.facebook.com/realofficialcrew with a presentation and the reasons of why you wanna enter the crew. 

Good luck ! And see you soon for more surprises. 
Re.A.L. team.
